title: Desenvolvedor full stack pleno
description:
A Listenx é líder em Music Branding na América latina.

Atuamos no modelo SAAS combinando tecnologia, música e anúncios no ponto de vendas para entregar comunicação estratégica e experiências musicais que fidelizam clientes e aumentam vendas.

Com soluções para todos os tamanhos de empresas, a Listenx está presente em mais de 16.000 clientes de todos os tamanhos no Brasil e América latina.

Somos apaixonados por música, tecnologia e inovação , crescemos em ritmo acelerado e estamos buscando pessoas para construir essa jornada junto com a gente.

✔️ Sua missão:

  • Você terá a missão de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações web em front-end e back-end, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e a melhor experiência para o usuário.

✔️É imprescindível que você conheça:

Linguagens e tecnologias

  • PHP (5, 7, 8), C#, Node.Js, .NET (4.5 ou superior), JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML 5, CSS

Banco de dados

  • MySQL, Doctrine (ORM)

Front-End

  • jQuery, AngularJS, React, Bootstrap, HTML 5, CSS, JavaScrip, TypeScript, ES6

Frameworks e Bibliotecas

  • NET (4.5 ou superior). AngularJS, Bootstrap, Framework PHP MVC (ex: Yii), Doctrine (ORM), React, Wordpress,

Servidores

  • Apache, NGINX, Docker

Metodologias

  • Scrum (ágeis), Kanban (ágeis), TDD

Controle de versão

  • Git

✔️Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Servidores Linux, React Native, NET CORE, Mensageria (SQS, RabbitMQ), Wordpress e Docker.

✔️Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Desenvolvimento de App's para TV (LG, Samsung, etc). Tecnologias com I.A., Python, AWS (EC2, RDS, Cloudfront), testes unitários e processos assíncronos.

✔️O que esperamos de você:

  • Perfil analítico
  • Qualidade nas entregas
  • Entregas no prazo
  • Organização e planejamento
  • Análise crítica

✔️Requisitos e diferenciais:

  • Acima de 5 anos de experiência: Desenvolvimento de software para web e aplicações desktop (Nível Pleno).
  • Superior concluído: Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação e afins.
  • Cursos Desejáveis : Cursos de lógica de programação, JavaScript, e afins.

✔️Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível
  • Ajuda de custo para home-office
  • Setup home-office (boas-vindas)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Descontos em Pós Graduação (FGV, FIAP, Mackenzie)
  • Inglês in company
  • Plataforma G4 para cursos online

✔️Mais informações:

  • Remuneração à combinar: informar pretensão na candidatura!
  • Horário de trabalho: Seg a sex (9h às 18h) - Jornada Flexível
  • Formato de contratação: CLT
  • Formato de trabalho: Híbrido (2 dias presenciais p/ semana)
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo - Região do Ipiranga (Zona Sul)
  • Oferecemos todos os equipamentos e periféricos

description:

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

title: Técnico de suporte ao usuário
description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Sobre a Vaga

Técnico de Suporte ao Usuário JR (Gestão de Ativos de TI)

Horário de trabalho: 07:00 as 17:00 horas ( Segunda a Sexta-Feira)

Modalidade: Presencial - Porto Real/RJ

O que você vai fazer

• O Técnico de Gestão de Ativos de TI é responsável pelo controle, atualização e acuracidade do inventário de ativos tecnológicos da organização. Atua de forma presencial e remota na validação, movimentação e registro de equipamentos, garantindo a integridade das informações no CMDB e o cumprimento dos processos definidos de gestão de ativos.

Requisitos

  • Cursando ou formado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins (desejável).
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de ativos de TI ou áreas relacionadas (desejável).
  • Conhecimentos em CMDB e ferramentas de inventário (ex.: MECM, SCCM, ServiceNow, ou similares).
  • Habilidade em pacote Office/Excel para controle e análise de dados.
  • Noções de logística de equipamentos de TI (transporte, recebimento e envio).
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Capacidade de organização, atenção a detalhes e proatividade na resolução de problemas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Executar inventário rotativo mensal de ativos de TI, de forma presencial (in loco) e remota.
  • Realizar identificação de equipamentos e garantir a rastreabilidade dos ativos.
  • Efetuar a validação física dos equipamentos no site da empresa e junto aos usuários.
  • Preparar e gerenciar o envio de equipamentos via transportadora (ex.: DHL) .
  • Realizar a atualização e manutenção de registros no CMDB , garantindo a acuracidade das informações.
  • Preencher e manter planilhas de controle de ativos, de acordo com as demandas do time e do cliente.
  • Conduzir validações e investigações de ativos que participam do inventário rotativo mensal.
  • Executar correções sob demanda , identificadas pelas áreas de Gestão de Ativos (GA), Field Services e/ou pelo cliente.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à gestão de ativos de TI.

Conhecimento técnicos desejáveis:

• Sistema operacional Windows;

• Office 365;

• Ferramentas de colaboração: Skype e Microsoft Teams;

• Active Directory (Administração de usuários);

• Fundamentos de Segurança em TI;

• Rede - conhecimento básico LAN/WAN;

Benefícios

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Vale transporte

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Trabalho remoto para gestantes

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.

About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.

Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.

Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.

  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).

  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.

Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).

Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.

  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets

  • Growing regional revenue contribution

  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on

Job Description

This role is pivotal in shaping the future of the dealer network by enforcing strong process discipline and enabling sustainable business growth.

  • Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.
  • Conduct dealership audits to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain compliance and performance.
  • Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.

Internal Stakeholders

  • Field Sales Teams
  • Service Teams
  • Finance
  • Legal

External Stakeholders

  • Dealership Owners

Impact & Contribution

  • Directly impacts dealer profitability, customer experience, and overall market performance.
  • Strengthens network capability through standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.
  • Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

title: Admissions Senior Data Analyst
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Avenues São Paulo Avenues São Paulo is excited to announce an opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Admissions, Enrollment, and Finance team. This critical role, reporting to Avenues São Paulo Finance, will support enrollment operations, processes, and analytics—transforming data into strategic insights that drive decision-making. As the owner of our enrollment database (from leads to post-event tracking and campaign performance), you will serve as the key liaison between Finance and Admissions. You will ensure that our data is accurately captured, clearly understood, and effectively reported. After completing enrollment data analyses, you will collaborate with various teams to translate insights into action across the organization.

ABOUT ADMISSIONS & FINANCE AT AVENUES

At Avenues São Paulo, the Admissions and Finance teams work in close partnership to ensure an exceptional experience for families and the long-term sustainability of our school.

The Admissions team is the first point of contact for prospective families, guiding and inspiring them as they learn about our unique global educational offering. With a high-touch, relationship-centered approach, Admissions provides a seamless and caring experience from inquiry to decision, ensuring each school year begins with a fully enrolled community of students who are an excellent match for Avenues and who bring diverse perspectives that enrich our campus.

The Finance team serves as a strategic partner to the school, stewarding resources responsibly to support Avenues’ long-term vision. Through ethical decision-making and comprehensive financial planning, Finance provides reliable, actionable data that informs key decisions, drives continuous improvement, and ensures the financial sustainability of the organization. The team is committed to delivering exceptional service to families and effectively managing the full financial cycle.

Together, Admissions and Finance work collaboratively to support families, strengthen operations, and uphold the mission and sustainability of Avenues São Paulo.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data analysis, interpretation, forecasting. Track and interpret all key metrics pertaining to the São Paulo campus such as (but not limited to) applications received, processed, erosion, yield and attrition. Be prepared and informed to answer sophisticated, multi-data, high-judgment questions.
  • Marketing data & events performance/analysis. Complete dashboard on all event performances and KPIs generating feedback, including enquiries, leads and prospects tracking. Connect event performance to applications and other data ensuring intersection of admissions results to events.
  • Ensure that the databases are always functioning properly and are accurate
  • Contribute as a key team member to the implementation of a new CRM platform, possibly SalesForce.
  • Be the expert of all aspects of data, ensuring clear, accurate, and timely reporting.
  • Oversee the backend database for all new and re-enrollments.

Qualifications

ABOUT YOU

  • You care deeply about making operational processes work smoothly for your teams through data analysis
  • You're an intrapreneur who's always thinking about how to improve any system or process
  • You're a good listener who manages all your relationships with empathy and grace
  • You're highly tech-savvy, particularly with tools like CRMs, databases and Excel
  • You're incredibly organized and attentive to every detail
  • You love working with data, gleaning insights from it and helping others to understand it
  • You love collaborating closely with a variety of stakeholders and colleagues, and do so in both English and Portuguese
  • You can juggle multiple, shifting priorities and deliver on challenging deadlines
  • The Avenues mission energizes and inspires you

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Closer (Executivo de Vendas)
description:
>>>> CANDIDATE-SE PELO LINK DA VAGA:

-

A Boomer é uma empresa brasileira especializada em mídia de performance para negócios digitais.

Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos de empresas que buscam previsibilidade, eficiência de investimento e expansão sustentável.

Nos últimos anos, consolidamos atuação nacional, atendendo empresas de diferentes portes e níveis de maturidade, sempre com critérios claros de performance e responsabilidade sobre resultados.

Entramos em um novo ciclo de evolução organizacional, com foco na consolidação de uma arquitetura comercial estruturada, previsível e independente de dependências individuais.

Buscamos profissionais que valorizem responsabilidade, consistência, maturidade técnica e compromisso com entrega.

Sede em Uberlândia/MG, com atuação em todo o Brasil.

Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas responsável por conduzir processos consultivos com executivos e fundadores, estruturando diagnósticos estratégicos e convertendo oportunidades em contratos da Boomer.

O profissional atuará no modelo de inbound e outbound, com responsabilidade direta sobre:

  • Conversão de leads qualificados em novos contratos;
  • Condução de reuniões estratégicas e diagnósticos executivos;
  • Gestão de pipeline e forecast no CRM;
  • Geração de oportunidades próprias (modelo full cycle);
  • Cumprimento de metas mensais definidas.

A função exige maturidade, organização e responsabilidade por entrega.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico com foco consultivo e estratégico;
  • Mapear dores, estágio de maturidade e potencial de crescimento do lead;
  • Construir e apresentar propostas comerciais alinhadas ao diagnóstico;
  • Garantir organização rigorosa do pipeline e previsibilidade de receita;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados e disciplinados;
  • Participar de rituais comerciais semanais e revisão de metas;
  • Gerar parte da própria demanda por meio de prospecção ativa qualificada.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas B2B;
  • Vivência com metas mensais e acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Organização e domínio de CRM (utilizamos Pipedrive);
  • Capacidade de argumentação, negociação e contorno de objeções;
  • Comunicação estruturada e postura profissional em reuniões executivas;
  • Disciplina com rotina comercial e follow-up.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas high ticket;
  • Vivência em empresas com cultura forte de metas e performance;
  • Conhecimento em marketing digital, mídia de performance ou crescimento digital;

Perfil comportamental esperado

  • Autonomia para conduzir processos sem dependência constante de liderança;
  • Responsabilidade por resultado e cumprimento de metas;
  • Organização e consistência na execução diária;
  • Postura madura diante de pressão e desafios;
  • Interesse em crescimento profissional proporcional à performance.

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding

UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.

Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.

You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

Main Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach

  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.

3. Strategy & CRM Excellence

  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.

Linguistic Versatility:

  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).
  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a "no-code" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.

Tech Stack

  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Backfill Support Engineer
description:

Contract: Long Term

Location: Ibirubá, Brazil United States

Scope of Work

This is a Backfill IT Support (Deskside Support) position for one of our clients in Jundiai, Brazil

The selected candidate will provide on-site technical support covering IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, and hardware troubleshooting. You will work closely with internal teams, customer teams, and remote technical specialists to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Responsibilities include monitoring system health, supporting network devices, troubleshooting VOIP phones, managing basic server tasks, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations following SLA guidelines.

Who We Are – Teceze

Teceze is a global IT solutions and managed services provider, delivering end-to-end support across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. We specialize in providing reliable, secure, and scalable IT services that empower organizations to operate seamlessly. By joining Teceze, you become part of a highly collaborative and technically strong team focused on excellence, innovation, and customer success.

This role is being offered as a backfill position for one of our key clients, ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining service quality on-site.

Basic Knowledge of Network Devices such as Switches, Routers, Wireless Access Points preferably CISCO, Riverbed

• Basics knowledge / understanding of assigning switch ports to specific VLANs

• Patch phone ports to switch as needed

• Basic troubleshooting of Avaya VOIP phones (knowledge on basic configuration)

• Troubleshoot issues with fiber links between switches – Able to visualize errors and communicate to remote technical teams

• Troubleshoot and replace network switch chassis blades when required

• Basic Knowledge of Monitoring tools such as Solarwinds, etc…

• Networking and Operating System basics

• Assist network and data center admins (Internal, Customer and Vendor) as required during the course of technical troubleshooting

• Basic knowledge about Hardware like Servers, Storage devices

• Knowledge to understand Monitoring Tool outcome

• Basic knowledge of ITSM tool preferably ServiceNow

• Basic knowledge Backup technologies preferably EMC Avamar

• Basic knowledge of Operating Systems- Windows 2003 servers Enterprise/Standard Edition, UNIX & linux

• Basic knowledge about Windows 2003 Active Directory structure, MS Exchange 2003 and File/Print Server

• Experience in SLA base environment

• Knowledge on Server Performance monitoring preferred

• Candidate should have minimum 3-5 years' experience in above mentioned area give me the scope of the job and who we are and how to apply

title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristics.

title: Innovation Procurement Coordinator
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Innovation Procurement Coordinator, you will be responsible for leading sourcing activities for NPD (New Product Development) initiatives across LATAM, ensuring cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and operational readiness for product launches.

You will act as the procurement focal point within cross-functional innovation teams, managing end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, risk mitigation, and alignment with global and regional category strategies.

This role requires strong project management capabilities, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with R&D, Marketing, Initiative Management, Planning, and Manufacturing to understand upcoming innovation pipelines (2–3 year horizon) and translate them into sourcing strategies, material requirements, and execution roadmaps.
  • Lead end-to-end procurement activities for new peoduct development projects, from brief validation and supplier scouting to commercial negotiation, supplier nomination, and production handover.
  • Manage RFQs, cost breakdown analysis, supplier benchmarking, and negotiations aligned with Category Procurement strategy and financial targets.
  • Drive Design-to-Cost discussions with cross-functional teams, challenging specifications and proposing alternative materials, technical optimizations, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Anticipate and mitigate supply risks, including tooling constraints, MOQ impacts, lead-time limitations, and supplier capacity risks.
  • Ensure pricing transparency, accurate forecasting inputs, and risk reporting prior to decision gates and launch approvals.
  • Track and report project savings, cost avoidance initiatives, and adherence to target cost objectives.
  • Act as escalation point for project-related supply disruptions until successful start of production (SOP).
  • Coordinate seamless transition from project phase to operational procurement and supply chain teams.
  • Influence stakeholders at managerial level, supporting data-driven decision-making and balancing commercial, technical, and timeline constraints.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, or Supply Chain, preferably within FMCG, beauty, pharma, or consumer goods industries.
  • Proven experience managing sourcing projects linked to product launches or innovation pipelines.
  • Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated cost management results.
  • Solid understanding of cost structures, supplier economics, and total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Advanced project management capabilities (PMO knowledge required).
  • Advanced Excel skills (cost modeling, scenario analysis); strong PowerPoint storytelling skills.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, or SRM systems is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English required; Spanish is a plus.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*

Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Analista de controle de qualidade
description:
Na Exeltis, acreditamos no poder da conexão, da ciência e da qualidade para transformar vidas.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Controle de Qualidade com olhar técnico, senso crítico e paixão por excelência, para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, contribuindo para que nossos processos mantenham o mais alto padrão de qualidade.

Se você é possui experiência em laboratório de controle de qualidade de medicamentos, é uma pessoa organizada, detalhista, comprometida e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que preza por qualidade em tudo o que faz, essa oportunidade é para você! ✨

Local de atuação: Goiânia/GO

Contratação via empresa parceira, com atuação dedicada à Exeltis.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar nas atividades do laboratório de Controle de Qualidade, assegurando o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL) e das legislações aplicáveis.
  • Realizar análises físico-químicas de produtos recebidos, conforme métodos analíticos vigentes.
  • Aplicar métodos e técnicas físico-químicas e instrumentais, utilizando equipamentos como HPLC/UPLC, espectrofotômetro UV, dissolutor, entre outros.
  • Revisar dossiês de controle de qualidade, análises terceirizadas e validações de métodos analíticos.
  • Conduzir e apoiar atividades de validação e desenvolvimento de metodologias analíticas.
  • Atuar em investigações laboratoriais para resultados fora de especificação (OOS).
  • Manusear, verificar e apoiar a manutenção, calibração e qualificação de equipamentos analíticos.
  • Apoiar atividades relacionadas a Controle de Mudanças, Desvios, Eventos da Qualidade e CAPAs.
  • Elaborar, revisar e manter procedimentos, registros e documentação do laboratório, garantindo rastreabilidade.
  • Apoiar treinamentos, orçamentos de materiais e serviços, além da rotina de conservação do laboratório.

Requisitos para brilhar nessa vaga:

  • Formação superior em Farmácia, Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em laboratório de Controle de Qualidade, com foco em liberação de lote e validação de métodos analíticos.
  • Experiência na operação de HPLC/UPLC, UV, dissolutor e demais equipamentos analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office.

Você vai arrasar se tiver:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês básico e/ou Espanhol.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento e validação de metodologias analíticas.

Habilidades que fazem a diferença:

  • Organização, disciplina e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Responsabilidade e comprometimento com qualidade.
  • Boa escrita, leitura e raciocínio lógico.
  • Facilidade de aprendizado e trabalho em equipe.

Se identificou?

Venha fazer parte da Família Sangue Azul e contribua para garantir a qualidade e a segurança que fazem parte do nosso propósito! ✨

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Analista de Customer Success
description:
➡️ Como Analista de Customer Success , você será o ponto focal e de relacionamento com uma carteira de clientes, garantindo uma experiência consistente e próxima, fortalecendo confiança, promovendo engajamento e apoiando a evolução da base.

  • Cumprir a régua de relacionamento definida, com registros atualizados e estruturados no CRM (HubSpot), garantindo visibilidade e continuidade no atendimento;

Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência anterior com atendimento, suporte, relacionamento com cliente ou Customer Success;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em empatia, clareza e escuta ativa;

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (como Hubspot) e plataformas de atendimento;
  • Facilidade para aprender ferramentas digitais e traduzir isso para o cliente com didática e leveza;
  • Desejável: experiência em empresas SaaS, tecnologia ou produtos digitais.

Mais informações:

title: Analista de Infra e Sistemas PL (Salesforce)
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

Requisitos

A área de TSI é responsável por realizar a sustenção e manutenção dos sistemas internos, mapeamentos de processos e governança dos sistemas, e busca um Analista de Infra e Sistemas PL (Salesforce) para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução.

Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Administrar usuários, perfis, conjunto de permissões, papéis.
  • Criar e manter:
  • Campos, objetos, layouts de página e record types
  • Regras de validação
  • Flows
  • Regras de atribuição, filas e automações declarativas
  • Processo de aprovação
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes e chamados (ex.: via Jira)
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de requisitos e melhorias
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados
  • Criar e manter relatórios e dashboards
  • Apoiar processos de deploy (sandbox → produção)
  • Documentar configurações e processos do Salesforce
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças (ex.: alteração de picklist, regras, automações)

Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência prática como Salesforce Administrator;
  • Conhecimento sólido em:
  • Security Model (Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules)
  • Flows
  • Relatórios e Dashboards
  • Objetos padrão (Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Case)
  • Noções de:
  • Integrações (REST, APIs – visão funcional);
  • Ambientes Sandbox e produção;
  • Deploy e Change Management (GMUD);
  • Capacidade de análise de impacto em mudanças no Salesforce.

Diferenciais (desejável)

  • Certificação Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201);
  • Experiência com:
  • Integrações com sistemas externos;
  • Apex;
  • LWC / Visualforce;
  • Auditorias (ex.: SOX);
  • Vivência em ambientes com alto volume de dados e integrações;
  • Experiência com Jira ou ferramentas similares de gestão de chamados.

IMPORTANTE: Essa oportunidade é para atuação nos escritórios da Evertec Brasil em São Paulo, modalidade (Hibrida).

title: Engenheiros de Dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de Dados experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

• Liderar a implantação de Data Lakes e Lakehouses, atuando tanto no desenho da arquitetura quanto no desenvolvimento hands-on da solução.

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis para garantir a fluidez entre sistemas.

• Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados em todas as etapas do pipeline.

• Otimizar processos de armazenamento e recuperação de dados, garantindo desempenho e custo eficientes (FINOPS).

• Implementar e monitorar processos ETL/ELT e arquiteturas de processamento de dados em tempo real e batch.

• Apoiar a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de dados dentro do time.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada em design e desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados escaláveis (preferencialmente em Oracle Cloud).

• Proficiência em SQL, Python e ferramentas de processamento de dados distribuídos (como Spark).

• Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code e práticas de CI/CD.

• Experiência com modelagem de dados e arquitetura de Data Lakes e Lakehouses.

• Forte entendimento de práticas de governança e qualidade de dados.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês fluente

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência

Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)

Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers

Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)

Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io

Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua

DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Assistente de auditoria
description:
Junte-se à Forvis Mazars

Se você busca propósito, crescimento contínuo e um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, seu lugar é aqui.

Seja parte de uma empresa líder em auditoria, consultoria tributária e consultoria empresarial, com presença em mais de 100 países e uma equipe de mais de 40.000 profissionais. Aqui, você terá acesso a exposição global, desenvolvimento contínuo e projetos que fazem a diferença.

Na Forvis Mazars, você cresce e pertence a uma rede diversa e gera impacto no mundo dos negócios e na sociedade. Faça parte de um ambiente colaborativo, onde suas ideias são valorizadas e onde o sucesso acontece em equipe.

Sobre a área

Na nossa área de auditoria, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional com interações e responsabilidades entre as principais linhas de frente de negócio, através disso você terá um contato maior com o time no que tange ao processo de auditoria desde o início de um projeto até o fim.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Prestar assistência nas atividades de prestação de serviços de auditoria contábil e financeira;
  • Auxiliar na análise e operacionalização dos trabalhos de investigação em documentos, saldos em conta corrente, bens e valores, análise de balanços consolidados e inventários físicos;

  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades contábeis;

Benefícios

  • Convênio com o SESC;

  • Vale Transporte;

  • Descontos e, incentivos educacionais em diversas instituições.

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)
